site.description: OSS main site set. Keeps app shell, JS/CSS, fonts, symbols, frame thumbnails, gallery assets, and legacy-compatible public paths that are not split into other release sets.

assets-hires.description: Cold high-resolution frame assets. Mount this set at the same public path or a CORS-enabled asset CDN before pointing Creator high-res loads away from the main site.

platform.description: Docker, launcher, OSS upload, and local deployment helpers. This target is not part of the default OSS main-site publish.
